scope: only/sole/last/full-service grocery-store loss, closure, fire, or disaster
canceled or suspended emergency food distributions due to storm, flood, fire, outage, or facility damage
abrupt pantry or food-bank closure or major access reduction
official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
coverage_notes.result: No new qualifying U.S. food-access disruption was identified since the prior hourly check.
notable_exclusions: Kaua'i hurricane-recovery coverage continued to list emergency food distributions as scheduled and SNAP replacement assistance as available; no new cancellation, suspension, or benefits interruption was identified.

A Jamaica, Queens fire began around 4:30 a.m. local time in a corner grocery store and spread to neighboring businesses; it occurred well before the bounded hourly window and available reporting did not establish that the store was the community's only, sole, last, or full-service grocery store.
Fresh search results also contained donation/fundraising items, routine program promotion, non-U.S. food-distribution stories, and older SNAP disruption coverage; all were excluded by watch scope.
